message.content: {"mechanism_id":"f-memory-recovery-via-stagnation-triggered-cauchy-resampling","target_component":"F memory update (M_F Lehmer mean) in L-SHADE","observed_evidence":{"task_id":"TASK-03","trace_path":"none_provided","function":"F4,F11,F15","seed":0,"metric":"F_mean trajectory","observed_value":0.06},"causal_hypothesis":"Lehmer mean overweights small successful F values, so once F drifts low, low-F trials still succeed on easy subproblems and reinforce collapse; a floor alone cannot restore lost diversity because M_F never re-explores high F.","algorithmic_change":"Detect per-memory-slot stagnation (no successful update to M_F[k] for G_stag generations) and, on trigger, resample that slot's M_F from Cauchy(0.5,0.2) truncated to [0.1,1.0] instead of Lehmer-averaging, preserving other slots.","mathematical_rule":"if G - last_update[k] > G_stag: M_F[k] = clip(Cauchy(0.5,0.2), 0.1, 1.0); last_update[k] = G; else: M_F[k] = Lehmer(S_F[k])","expected_effect":"Restores M_F to effective range on F4/F11/F15, keeping differential vectors non-vanishing while leaving productive slots untouched.","failure_prediction":"On unimodal functions where low F is genuinely optimal, forced resampling may slow convergence and increase variance in final fitness.","ablation_plan":"Compare (a) baseline, (b) simple F floor, (c) proposed stagnation-triggered resampling, (d) resampling with G_stag=5 vs 20, across F4/F11/F15 and unimodal controls, 25 seeds.","nearest_known_methods":"SHADE memory update, jSO F reset, L-SHADE restart strategies, adaptive F floor heuristics.","implementation_requirements":"Track last_update[k] per memory slot; add G_stag hyperparameter (default 15); modify M_F update branch in lshade_canonical.py; log M_F trajectories."}
